name: Baseline interaction cleanup
summary: Baseline interaction cleanup: centre the Attention counter in a square badge, implement Find destination as Content item → unpopulated image chooser, and standardise campaign actions to a single ghost icon or ellipsis menu.
scope: Three tightly scoped interaction fixes. (1) Attention nav counter: flex-centred, approximately square, 4px radius, horizontal growth for larger values. (2) Find destination: staged popover selecting campaign content then an unpopulated image-chooser field by visible title; linking updates the existing content/asset graph. (3) Campaign actions: Archive ghost icon for Needs attention and Needs review; Duplicate + Archive overflow menu for Signed off.
preserve: Full Campaigns table → select row → in-situ split view → inspect → close → restore full table.
Campaign Production remains a control layer and wayfinder over CMS, DAM and Jira rather than replacing those systems.
Attention states are actionable and resolving an item updates surrounding workflow state.
Human checkpoints remain visible around consequential or uncertain automated steps.
Default landing view remains the Attention tab.

validation.notes: Accepted after local verification of Attention counter geometry, Find destination hierarchy, and campaign action ghost/ellipsis controls.
